description: Host an image for use in email HTML: a logo or photo in a template, a campaign or an automation step. Returns a media object whose url goes in an ; it is served from the workspace's own tracking domain (https://link./media/...), and the url is public to anyone who has it. Images only: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP up to 5 MB, judged by the file's bytes. A PDF, document, video or SVG is refused with 422 invalid_request; a file for a recipient is an attachment on the email, not media. Prefer source_url, a public http(s) address the image is fetched from (no redirects, no private addresses); content is the base64 bytes and is only practical for small images. The image is re-encoded, so content_type, size, width and height describe the stored image and WebP comes back as PNG, JPEG or GIF. The same image uploaded again returns the one already stored. 409 invalid_state means no sending domain has a live tracking record yet (list_sending_domains shows the record to publish); 402 payment_method_required needs a person to add a card in the dashboard; 402 plan_limit_reached means the workspace holds its maximum (delete_media frees room). Call it rather than predicting the outcome: many workspaces need no card (get_usage shows payment_method.required false), so a missing card in get_usage is not a reason to skip the upload.

content.description: The image as base64, or a data: URL. Exactly one of source_url and content

filename.description: A label for the image, e.g. logo.png. Not part of its URL

source_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image. Exactly one of source_url and content

name: upload_media
